_comment: Vocabulary the checker in tests/behavior/run.py needs in order to parse THIS
language's own model answers. Kept here, in the ru folder, the same way cases.json
and answers/ are - so the shared checker (run.py) itself can stay English, and a
new language folder (uk, en, ...) adds its own copy of this file alongside its own
cases.json instead of teaching run.py another language's words.
